messages:
avery: FYI: Customer 'NorthBridge' opened an escalated ticket — SIEM ingest shows a ~2h gap of audit events for tenant northbridge-prod around 2026-02-12 02:10-04:10 UTC. They say Splunk shows nothing for that window.

kpatel: Ack. Any forwarder errors from our side?

support-bot: Incident created: INC-20260212-874. Linked alert: audit-export-drop. Tags: tenant:northbridge-prod, priority:high.

avery: I pulled the forwarder logs from s3-forwarder-prod shard-7. See snippet below — looks like repeated backoff + 403s when trying to fetch KMS decryption key around 02:09–02:15 UTC:```2026-02-12T02:09:34Z ERROR forwarder Sender failed to decrypt envelope: AccessDeniedException keyAlias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-... status=403 retrying in 120s```

mike_r: Hmm 403 on decrypt usually implies KMS key policy or IAM role change. Any recent rotation?

kpatel: We rotated a CMK alias for env isolation last week (2026-02-05). But rotation should be seamless — how many tenants use that CMK?

avery: Only dedicated-tenant CMKs: northbridge-prod, sunrise-inc, and a few others. The logs show retry/backoff continued until ~02:30, then network timeouts. After that forwarder resumed but there are still missing events.

sophia_l: Could this be our forwarder queuing behavior — if decrypt fails for a batch we backoff and skip later batches? Need repro.

kpatel: Check forwarder config: we mark batch as transient-fail and schedule replays. But there's a rate-limiter that caps replay per-minute for tenant to avoid SIEM bursts. If backoff windows overlap with retention partitioning, events may fall out of retention window before replay.

avery: That would explain permanent loss. Customer retention policy for audit-export is 7 days pre-ingest; forwarder replays rely on raw bucket slices. If replay delayed > retention window we can't resend.

oncall: I'm on call — what immediate mitigation can we offer customer?

mike_r: Short-term: increase replay rate and bump retention for that tenant's raw bucket (if possible) to allow replay. Ops can temporarily disable rate-limiter for northbridge-prod and kick manual replay job.

sophia_l: Can we confirm if KMS alias rotation left an alias name mismatch? Maybe forwarder used alias 'rbw-nb-prod' but CMK alias changed to 'rbw-nb-prod-rot2'. If alias change caused AccessDenied for the decrypt, IAM principal might lack key:Decrypt on new alias. Need KMS audit.

avery: I grabbed KMS CloudTrail around 02:05-02:20: there are ReEncrypt/Decrypt failures with the same key-id and principal arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/forwarder-role. No PutKeyPolicy changes at that time.

kpatel: Two hypotheses: (1) IAM role temporary credential expiration concurrent with replay window (short-lived STS) causing 403; (2) key policy condition added (e.g., sourceVPC) denying decrypt for forwarder IPs.

mike_r: I can run a targeted repro: create a small batch using northbridge key alias and attempt decrypt with forwarder-role creds. If repro fails, we surface exact error.

avery: Steps I followed earlier: 1) find one raw batch file s3://audit-raw/northbridge/2026-02-12/02-09-... 2) run aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://batch.envelope --key-id alias/rbw-nb-prod --profile forwarder-role 3) observed AccessDenied.

sophia_l: If that's reproducible, we should escalate to security infra to validate key policy and IAM role trust. Also validate HSM rotation logs if customer uses HSM-wrapped keys.

oncall: Agreed. Action items: (1) mike_r to run repro in staging and report exact error string (ETA 30m). (2) ops to temporarily increase replay window and disable tenant rate-limit for northbridge-prod (ETA 45m). (3) kpatel to audit KMS key policy and CloudTrail for PutKeyPolicy/Grant changes (ETA 1h). (4) support to notify customer we're working a replay/retention mitigation and will restore missing events if possible.

kpatel: One more check — schema mismatch concerns: customer mentioned some events that did make it were missing identity fields (tenant_id). That could be post-processing normalizer dropping events that failed schema validation. Need to check normalizer logs at same window.

avery: Good catch. I'll pull normalizer validation errors. If both decrypt + schema drop happened, we might only have a partial set.

mike_r: Update: repro in staging yields: "Decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd" — also observed that forwarder-role temporary creds had an invalid session duration at 02:07 due to STS token exchange failure. Suspect short STS TTL bug in the token refresh logic.

sophia_l: If it's the STS token refresh bug, we should patch forwarder immediately — small code change to refresh earlier. For now, we still need to proceed with replay to recover events.

oncall: I'll coordinate ops and patch rollout. Support: please send customer a status update noting potential root cause (temporary credential refresh failure -> KMS decrypts failed -> backoff -> replay window exceeded). Offer to run manual backfill once retention extended.

support-bot: Support note posted to INC-20260212-874: "Interim: Ops expanded retention window for northbridge-prod raw bucket and triggered manual replay. Engineering investigating STS token refresh bug that caused decrypt failures."

avery: Thanks team. I'll attach the normalizer logs and s3 object list to the incident. We'll follow up after patch and replay results. :thumbsup:
